messages:
Alex (Finance): Morning  spotted a sharp uptick in Feb GPU charges for hosted-models. Need a quick allocation by team/customer for the provisional invoice.

billing-bot: Alert: gpu_cost > expected for project=hosted-models since 2026-02-13. Link: /alerts/177800.

Jamie (Infra): Can you paste the top cost rows or run cost-lookup? Untagged jobs usually land in shared.

Alex (Finance): Snippet from cost API:
`2026-02-14 hosted-models gpu A100 $27,900 tags: team=null,customer=acme`
`2026-02-15 hosted-models gpu A100 $15,600 tags: team=platform,customer=internal`

Jamie (Infra): Run: `cost-lookup --project hosted-models --from 2026-02-12 --to 2026-02-16 --filter "tag:team==null" --group-by job_name`  will map job_name -> CODEOWNERS and send a CSV.

Priya (ML): That $27.9k line is our `embed-quant-sweep`. We accidentally used non-preemptible template. Sorry  will cover portion and request transfer for the rest.

Alex (Finance): Got CSV. Provisional allocation: ML $24,500, Platform $13,000, Internal tooling $6,000. Filing transfer ticket FIN-5032 (pre-approve up to $15k).

Jamie (Infra): Short-term: enforced mandatory `--team` on submits and 24h cap on sweep templates. Will add a billing-guardrail ticket for the UI.
